The Canary Calls#001.src: Find out what's happening at the {p} coal mine at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Canary Calls#001.dst: 查明 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 {p} 煤矿发生了什么事。

The Canary Calls#002.src: Phew... Everyone make it out alright? That was...one hell of a sprint. I'm absolutely knackered.
The Canary Calls#002.dst: 呼……大家都平安出来了吧？刚才那一路狂奔……真要命。我累瘫了。
The Canary Calls#002.speaker: Daffyd

The Canary Calls#003.src: I'm not sure, mate. I left a bunch of my stuff down there. Who knows if I'll get it back.
The Canary Calls#003.dst: 我不确定，伙计。我有一堆东西落在下面了。天知道还拿不拿得回来。
The Canary Calls#003.speaker: Micho

The Canary Calls#004.src: Forget about that, what are we gonna tell the chief? That chopsy old fool is gonna kill us if he sees us not working.
The Canary Calls#004.dst: 别管那些了，我们要怎么跟工头交代？那个嘴碎的老糊涂要是看到我们没在干活，肯定会宰了我们。
The Canary Calls#004.speaker: Daffyd

The Canary Calls#005.src: Oi, you! Listen, there was some kind of explosion down in the mines. We're not sure what it is or where it came from, but it surely didn't sound good.
The Canary Calls#005.dst: 喂，你！听着，矿坑下面发生了某种爆炸。我们不确定是什么，也不知道从哪来的，但听起来肯定不妙。
The Canary Calls#005.speaker: Daffyd

The Canary Calls#006.src: The four of us were the only blokes down in the mines, so everyone should be out safely. But I reckon we can't go back if this issue isn't resolved.
The Canary Calls#006.dst: 下面就只有我们四个人，所以大家应该都安全出来了。不过我看问题没解决之前，我们是不能回去了。
The Canary Calls#006.speaker: Daffyd

The Canary Calls#007.src: You must go to the chief and tell him about the situation. Head down this mineshaft and turn left, and he should be there.
The Canary Calls#007.dst: 你一定要去找工头，告诉他现在的情况。沿着这条矿井下去再左转，他应该就在那里。
The Canary Calls#007.speaker: Daffyd

The Canary Calls#008.src: Just, uh... Make sure not to mention us by name. Now, if you'll excuse us, we'll...be on our way.
The Canary Calls#008.dst: 只是，呃……千万别提我们的名字。好了，失陪了，我们……先走一步。
The Canary Calls#008.speaker: Daffyd

The Canary Calls#009.src: Turn left from the mine's entrance and speak to the chief at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Canary Calls#009.dst: 从矿坑入口左转，与 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的工头交谈。

The Canary Calls#010.src: That's right, keep it moving! The whole of {p} is going to run out of coal at this pace!
The Canary Calls#010.dst: 没错，动作别停！照这个速度，整个 {p} 都要没煤用了！
The Canary Calls#010.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#011.src: Eh? What do you want? Only registered miners are allowed beyond this point. Speak up or get off the premises.
The Canary Calls#011.dst: 嗯？你想干嘛？只有登记在册的矿工才能进去。有话快说，不然就滚出去。
The Canary Calls#011.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#012.src: ...An explosion? In the mines? Just now?
The Canary Calls#012.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#013.src: EMERGENCY BREAK TIME, YOU GERBILS! EVERYONE COME AND MEET ME BY THE ENTRANCE! NOW!!!
The Canary Calls#013.dst: 紧急休息时间，你们这群沙鼠！所有人都到入口来见我！马上！！！
The Canary Calls#013.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#014.src: Alright, you lot better listen bloody carefully. An explosion has been reported in the mines. You all know what that means, yes?
The Canary Calls#014.dst: 好了，你们这帮家伙给我仔细听好。矿坑里传出了爆炸。你们都知道那代表什么，对吧？
The Canary Calls#014.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#019.src: No, you bunch of ingrates! One of you needs to take the ol' canary down to the mines and see whatever the hell's going on.
The Canary Calls#019.dst: 不是，你们这群不知感恩的东西！你们其中一个得带着老金丝雀下矿坑，看看到底他妈的怎么回事。
The Canary Calls#019.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#020.src: Now, which one of you blokes would be willing to-
The Canary Calls#020.dst: 好了，你们哪个家伙愿意——
The Canary Calls#020.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#022.src: Right then. I guess that leaves you, young lad. What do you say? Want a job?
The Canary Calls#022.dst: 那好。看来就剩你了，年轻人。怎么样？想接个活吗？
The Canary Calls#022.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#024.src: You sure? I'll pay a lot, and it won't be dangerous. Even if it is, you've got all that armor on you!
The Canary Calls#024.dst: 你确定？我会付很多钱，而且不会有危险。就算有，你身上也穿着那么多盔甲！
The Canary Calls#024.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#025.src: That's the spirit! Come on then, let me introduce you to our little feathered mascot.
The Canary Calls#025.dst: 这才对嘛！来吧，我给你介绍一下我们毛茸茸的小吉祥物。
The Canary Calls#025.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#026.src: You'll get a bloody mountain of emeralds, god damn it! This is a once in a lifetime opportunity! Do you want it or not?
The Canary Calls#026.dst: 你会拿到一大座山的绿宝石，该死！这是千载难逢的机会！你到底要不要？
The Canary Calls#026.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#027.src: Good. Now, hurry up and follow me.
The Canary Calls#027.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#028.src: You know what? This is ridiculous. The whole of {p} is at danger, and you're playing games with ME?! I know you can do it. Follow me. Now.
The Canary Calls#028.dst: 你知道吗？这太荒唐了。整个 {p} 都有危险，你还在跟我玩游戏？！我知道你做得到。跟我来。马上。
The Canary Calls#028.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#029.src: Scared speechless, eh? Don't worry, it'll be an easy job. Come on, follow me to the canary's cage.
The Canary Calls#029.dst: 吓得说不出话了，嗯？别担心，这是个简单的活。来吧，跟我去金丝雀的笼子那边。
The Canary Calls#029.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#030.src: Meet our canary! She's such a beaut.
The Canary Calls#030.dst: 来见见我们的金丝雀！她可真是个美人。
The Canary Calls#030.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#031.src: You see, whenever we hear news of an explosion we always bring our canary with us to check it out. They can detect potential gases much earlier than we can.
The Canary Calls#031.dst: 你看，每次听到有爆炸，我们都会带着金丝雀去查看。它们能比我们更早察觉到可能存在的毒气。
The Canary Calls#031.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#032.src: Let me just get the key and-
The Canary Calls#032.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#033.src: WAIT, WHAT? WHERE'S THE BLOODY KEY? WHICH ONE OF YOUR LOT IS RESPONSIBLE?! I SWEAR I'M GONNA...
The Canary Calls#033.dst: 等等，什么？该死的钥匙呢？你们哪个家伙干的？！我发誓我要……
The Canary Calls#033.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#034.src: ...Listen up, lad. Take this toothpick I've been chewing on. I need you to pick the cage's lock. It's a little wet, but it should do the trick. Understood? Good, now hurry up!
The Canary Calls#034.dst: ……听着，年轻人。拿着这根我一直在嚼的牙签。我需要你把笼子的锁撬开。它有点湿，不过应该管用。懂了吗？很好，现在快点！
The Canary Calls#034.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#036.src: Doing just fine, lad. Almost there...
The Canary Calls#036.dst: 干得不错，年轻人。快好了……
The Canary Calls#036.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#037.src: Little old birdie is getting quite excited! Keep it up.
The Canary Calls#037.dst: 小鸟儿越来越兴奋了！继续。
The Canary Calls#037.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#038.src: Right then, lad! It's time to begin the-
The Canary Calls#038.dst: 好了，年轻人！是时候开始——
The Canary Calls#038.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#039.src: OW! Bloody hell! Those are some freakishly sharp claws! What are you playing at-
The Canary Calls#039.dst: 哎哟！该死！这爪子也太尖了！你在搞什么——
The Canary Calls#039.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#040.src: Well, I think she likes you, lad. Doesn't like me, apparently.
The Canary Calls#040.dst: 嗯，我看她挺喜欢你的，年轻人。显然不喜欢我。
The Canary Calls#040.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#041.src: I was going to feed her, but I suppose you can do the honors. Or not, seeing as she's been particularly troublesome...
The Canary Calls#041.dst: 我本来要喂她的，不过我想这个荣幸就交给你吧。或者不喂也行，毕竟她特别麻烦……
The Canary Calls#041.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#042.src: Anyway, do as you please. I'll be waiting by the elevator in the mineshaft. Hurry up, and don't make me wait!
The Canary Calls#042.dst: 总之，随你便。我会在矿井里的升降梯旁边等你。快点，别让我等！
The Canary Calls#042.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#043.src: Head to the mine elevator at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Canary Calls#044.src: Right then, lad! I suppose you might want to know more about this job.
The Canary Calls#044.dst: 好了，年轻人！我想你大概想多了解一下这份活。
The Canary Calls#044.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#045.src: As I said before, when unknown explosions occur in the mines, that's usually a sign that something bad happened.
The Canary Calls#045.dst: 就像我之前说的，矿坑里发生不明爆炸，通常代表出了什么坏事。
The Canary Calls#045.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#046.src: Most of the time, an awfully putrid gas appears. This is where our canary comes in. Once she verifies that a gas is present, we decide whether or not to temporarily close the mine.
The Canary Calls#046.dst: 大多数时候，会冒出一股臭得要命的毒气。这时就轮到我们的金丝雀出场了。一旦她确认有毒气，我们就决定要不要暂时关闭矿坑。
The Canary Calls#046.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#047.src: I presume you met Daffyd and his group, correct? Thankfully, they were the only ones down in the mines.
The Canary Calls#047.dst: 我猜你见过 Daffyd 他们那伙人了，对吧？幸好下面就只有他们。
The Canary Calls#047.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#048.src: ...Wait, where the hell even are they? Did I not tell them to...
The Canary Calls#048.dst: ……等等，他们到底跑哪去了？我不是叫他们……
The Canary Calls#048.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#049.src: Eh, doesn't matter. Lad, point is, I want you to check whether the gas is still there, if at all.
The Canary Calls#049.dst: 呃，算了。年轻人，重点是，我要你去确认毒气还在不在，如果有的话。
The Canary Calls#049.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#050.src: We'll use the elevator behind me to get down to the mines. Just let me pull this here lever to activate it...
The Canary Calls#050.dst: 我们用我后面的升降梯下去矿坑。我拉一下这根拉杆启动它……
The Canary Calls#050.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#051.src: ...WHY ISN'T THIS BLOODY CONTRAPTION WORKING??! WORK, WORK, GOD DAMN IT!!
The Canary Calls#051.dst: ……这该死的玩意为什么不动？？！动啊，动啊，该死的！！
The Canary Calls#051.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#052.src: Must've been Daffyd and his group... No worries, lad. I've got, uh... a last resort, so to speak.
The Canary Calls#052.dst: 肯定是 Daffyd 他们那伙人干的……别担心，年轻人。我还有，呃……可以说是最后的手段。
The Canary Calls#052.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#053.src: You'll need to ride a minecart down into the mines. Thing is, we haven't used them to transport people in...years.
The Canary Calls#053.dst: 你得搭矿车下去矿坑。问题是，我们已经……好几年没用矿车载人了。
The Canary Calls#053.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#054.src: Why? Erm, well... See for yourself.
The Canary Calls#054.dst: 为什么？呃，这个嘛……你自己看吧。
The Canary Calls#054.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#055.src: Our transporter minecarts are manual. Miners around here prefer automatic.
The Canary Calls#055.dst: 我们的运输矿车是手动的。这里的矿工比较喜欢自动的。
The Canary Calls#055.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#056.src: For you, it should be no issue controlling it. There's instructions attached to the gear stick.
The Canary Calls#056.dst: 对你来说，操纵它应该没问题。变速杆上附了说明。
The Canary Calls#056.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#057.src: Now then, go into the mineshaft, following the rails behind me. You'll be able to summon a minecart there.
The Canary Calls#057.dst: 好了，沿着我后面的铁轨进入矿井。你可以在那里召唤矿车。
The Canary Calls#057.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#058.src: Use the rails to get to the gas leakage.
The Canary Calls#058.dst: 利用铁轨前往毒气泄漏处。

The Canary Calls#059.src: Follow the rail tracks and find a way to escape the mine
The Canary Calls#059.dst: 沿着铁轨，找到逃出矿坑的方法

The Canary Calls#060.src: Continue further in the mine to find a way out.
The Canary Calls#060.dst: 继续深入矿坑寻找出路。

The Canary Calls#063.src: I am but a figment of your imagination. To you, I am not real.
The Canary Calls#063.dst: 我只是你想象出来的产物。对你来说，我并不真实。
The Canary Calls#063.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#064.src: The mysterious force that brought death upon me... It changed me.
The Canary Calls#064.dst: 那股让我丧命的神秘力量……改变了我。
The Canary Calls#064.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#065.src: So too will it change you. I will make that happen. Just for you.
The Canary Calls#065.dst: 它也会改变你。我会让那发生的。专门为你。
The Canary Calls#065.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#066.src: No need to thank me. It is the least I can do.
The Canary Calls#066.dst: 不用谢我。这是我起码能做的。
The Canary Calls#066.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#067.src: Moments like these are cherished. Savor the moment with me. Would you like to die with me?
The Canary Calls#067.dst: 这样的时刻值得珍惜。跟我一起细细品味吧。你愿意跟我一起死吗？
The Canary Calls#067.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#068.src: I see. So you want to make this an unforgettable experience. I appreciate the thoughtfulness.
The Canary Calls#068.dst: 我明白了。所以你想让这成为一次难忘的经历。我很感谢你的体贴。
The Canary Calls#068.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#070.src: I was hoping we could stay for a little longer. If that is your choice, then so be it.
The Canary Calls#070.dst: 我本来希望我们能多待一会儿。如果那是你的选择，那就这样吧。
The Canary Calls#070.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#071.src: See you on the other side.
The Canary Calls#071.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#072.src: I would be more than glad to. Sit back and relax.
The Canary Calls#072.dst: 我非常乐意。坐好，放轻松。
The Canary Calls#072.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#074.src: Mine could have been better. Cramped up in a cage all day, then suddenly witnessing my death in front of an incompetent human.
The Canary Calls#074.dst: 我的本来可以更好。一整天被关在笼子里，然后突然在一个无能的人类面前目睹自己死去。
The Canary Calls#074.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#075.src: You couldn't even save me. How pathetic.
The Canary Calls#075.dst: 你连救都救不了我。真可悲。
The Canary Calls#075.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#076.src: So, anyway, do you come here often?
The Canary Calls#076.dst: 那么，总之，你常来这里吗？
The Canary Calls#076.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#077.src: Oh, wait. This is your first time. As well as your last time. That's very poetic. Do you want to become a poet?
The Canary Calls#077.dst: 噢，等等。这是你第一次来。也是你最后一次。真有诗意。你想当诗人吗？
The Canary Calls#077.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#078.src: I know a good poem. Want to hear it?
The Canary Calls#078.dst: 我知道一首好诗。想听吗？
The Canary Calls#078.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#086.src: You will lose a lot of things,
The Canary Calls#086.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#101.src: The most average Joe I've seen,
The Canary Calls#101.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#103.src: How was that? It was beautiful, wasn't it?
The Canary Calls#103.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#104.src: Silence is bliss. You must not have very many friends.
The Canary Calls#104.dst: 沉默是福。你一定没什么朋友。
The Canary Calls#104.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#105.src: That's okay. I am your friend. Am I your friend? Please say yes. I'm very lonely.
The Canary Calls#105.dst: 没关系。我是你的朋友。我是你的朋友吗？请说是。我很寂寞。
The Canary Calls#105.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#106.src: I had friends too, once. They were all taken by a bunch of selfish coal miners. Then died to their incompetence.
The Canary Calls#106.dst: 我以前也有朋友。它们全被一群自私的煤矿工人带走了。然后死于他们的无能。
The Canary Calls#106.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#107.src: But you are different. You are not like the others. I like you. I love you. I love you so much.
The Canary Calls#107.dst: 但你不一样。你跟其他人不同。我喜欢你。我爱你。我好爱你。
The Canary Calls#107.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#122.src: I will give you another chance to redeem yourself.
The Canary Calls#122.dst: 我再给你一次赎罪的机会。
The Canary Calls#122.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#123.src: So kindly, I will tell you again.
The Canary Calls#123.dst: 我就好心地再跟你说一遍。
The Canary Calls#123.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#125.src: Let's do a little warm-up, shall we?
The Canary Calls#125.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#126.src: Liked the dance party? Those moves were so utterly terrible, I may as well dub them 'The '.
The Canary Calls#126.dst: 喜欢这场舞会吗？那些舞步烂透了，我干脆把它们命名为“ ”好了。
The Canary Calls#126.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#127.src: Let's do something I like to call, 'The Canary'.
The Canary Calls#127.dst: 我们来跳一支我称为“金丝雀”的舞吧。
The Canary Calls#127.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#128.src: Hands off those, if you would be so kind.
The Canary Calls#128.dst: 那些东西请别碰，拜托了。
The Canary Calls#128.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#129.dst: 太棒了……这感觉真不一样。
The Canary Calls#129.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#135.src: Indeed, you are the one who can destroy the Colossus. (In High Gavellian)
The Canary Calls#135.dst: 没错，你就是能摧毁巨像的人。(高等 Gavel 语)
The Canary Calls#135.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#139.src: You are about to enter the cruel, real world.
The Canary Calls#139.dst: 你就要进入残酷的现实世界了。
The Canary Calls#139.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#140.src: Kill me now, so we can spend our final moments together in bliss.
The Canary Calls#140.dst: 现在杀了我，这样我们就能幸福地共度最后的时光。
The Canary Calls#140.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#141.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#141.dst: 太棒了。你是人类的巅峰。
The Canary Calls#141.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#144.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#144.dst: 太棒了。你是人类的巅峰。
The Canary Calls#144.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#146.src: Kill me now or you'll live to regret it.
The Canary Calls#146.dst: 现在杀了我，不然你会后悔一辈子。
The Canary Calls#146.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#147.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#147.dst: 太棒了。你是人类的巅峰。
The Canary Calls#147.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#149.src: Kill me now or I'll destroy {p}.
The Canary Calls#149.dst: 现在杀了我，不然我就毁掉 {p}。
The Canary Calls#149.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#150.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#150.dst: 太棒了。你是人类的巅峰。
The Canary Calls#150.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#152.src: Kill me now or I'll destroy Gavel.
The Canary Calls#152.dst: 现在杀了我，不然我就毁掉 Gavel。
The Canary Calls#152.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#153.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#153.dst: 太棒了。你是人类的巅峰。
The Canary Calls#153.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#155.src: Kill me now or I'll ruin every single province.
The Canary Calls#155.dst: 现在杀了我，不然我就毁掉每一个行省。
The Canary Calls#155.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#156.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#156.dst: 太棒了。你是人类的巅峰。
The Canary Calls#156.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#158.src: Kill me now or I'll destroy the world.
The Canary Calls#158.dst: 现在杀了我，不然我就毁灭世界。
The Canary Calls#158.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#159.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#159.dst: 太棒了。你是人类的巅峰。
The Canary Calls#159.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#161.src: Okay so you don't care about the world. In that case, kill me now or I'll kill your friends.
The Canary Calls#161.dst: 好吧，所以你不在乎这个世界。既然如此，现在杀了我，不然我就杀了你的朋友。
The Canary Calls#161.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#162.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#162.dst: 太棒了。你是人类的巅峰。
The Canary Calls#162.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#165.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#165.dst: 太棒了。你是人类的巅峰。
The Canary Calls#165.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#167.src: Kill me now or I'll do LITERALLY ANYTHING!
The Canary Calls#167.dst: 现在杀了我，不然我什么事都干得出来！
The Canary Calls#167.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#168.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#168.dst: 太棒了。你是人类的巅峰。
The Canary Calls#168.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#170.src: No no. No no no no no. No. It's too late.
The Canary Calls#170.dst: 不不。不不不不不。不。太迟了。
The Canary Calls#170.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#171.src: I just wanted to play again. Oh well.
The Canary Calls#171.dst: 我只是想再玩一次。算了。
The Canary Calls#171.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#172.src: At least I'll be in your memories. Forever. And ever.
The Canary Calls#172.dst: 至少我会留在你的记忆里。永远。永永远远。
The Canary Calls#172.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#175.src: Keep performing CPR, they're almost awake!
The Canary Calls#175.dst: 继续做心肺复苏，他们快醒了！
The Canary Calls#175.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#176.src: No way! I actually did it! I saved their life!
The Canary Calls#176.dst: 不会吧！我真的做到了！我救了他们一命！
The Canary Calls#176.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#177.src: We better get a raise for this!
The Canary Calls#177.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#178.src: What the?! Who the hell let you in my house?
The Canary Calls#178.dst: 搞什么？！谁他妈让你们进我家的？
The Canary Calls#178.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#180.src: No, you can't. Get outta here before I start lowering your salary.
The Canary Calls#180.dst: 不，你不能。趁我还没开始扣你工钱，快滚出去。
The Canary Calls#180.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#183.src: Well then, lad! Despite their incompetence, they still managed to save your skin.
The Canary Calls#183.dst: 好了，年轻人！虽然他们很无能，还是救了你一命。
The Canary Calls#183.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#184.src: Come speak to me for a quick debriefing.
The Canary Calls#184.dst: 过来跟我简单汇报一下。
The Canary Calls#184.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#186.src: I sent my miners down to save you as soon as we felt that earthquake. It was so strong that I genuinely thought the world was ending.
The Canary Calls#186.dst: 我们一感觉到那场地震，我就派矿工下去救你。震得那么厉害，我真心以为世界末日到了。
The Canary Calls#186.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#187.src: I'm jolly sorry for forcing you to take on this job. This whole situation was completely unexpected.
The Canary Calls#187.dst: 硬逼你接下这份活，我真的非常抱歉。整件事完全出乎意料。
The Canary Calls#187.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#188.src: Typically, gases are cleared up almost instantly. This time, however, it seemed to have been a lot more potent... But how?
The Canary Calls#188.dst: 一般来说，毒气几乎马上就会散掉。可这一次，它似乎强烈得多……但为什么？
The Canary Calls#188.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#189.src: ...{p}. It stirs once more. That thing... It has already caused too much hardship for this area to handle.
The Canary Calls#189.dst: ……{p}。它又开始躁动了。那东西……已经给这一带带来太多苦难了。
The Canary Calls#189.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#190.src: It must be destroyed, once and for all. How will that happen, I do not know. But you...
The Canary Calls#190.dst: 必须一劳永逸地摧毁它。要怎么做到，我不知道。但是你……
The Canary Calls#190.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#192.src: Tell you what, lad! I'll give you, and only you, permission to access parts of the mine, right where we mine our world-famous {p} coal.
The Canary Calls#192.dst: 这样吧，年轻人！我给你，也只给你，进入矿坑某些区域的许可，就是我们开采举世闻名的 {p} 煤的地方。
The Canary Calls#192.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#193.src: Consider yourself a part-time {p} coal miner. You've earned it, lad.
The Canary Calls#193.dst: 就当你是 {p} 的兼职煤矿工吧。这是你应得的，年轻人。
The Canary Calls#193.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#196.src: Is this the height of your skill?
The Canary Calls#196.dst: 这就是你的最高水准吗？
The Canary Calls#196.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#198.src: Are you even playing the game?
The Canary Calls#198.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#199.src: Go ahead. Run right into it.
The Canary Calls#199.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#200.src: Was that you, or will you blame that on lag?
The Canary Calls#200.dst: 那是你自己的问题，还是你要怪到网络延迟上？
The Canary Calls#200.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#202.src: Even a snail could dodge that.
The Canary Calls#202.dst: 连蜗牛都躲得开那一下。
The Canary Calls#202.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#204.src: Nice going bozo, you fell off.
The Canary Calls#204.dst: 干得好啊笨蛋，你掉下去了。
The Canary Calls#204.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#205.dst: 有意思的战术！再来一次。
The Canary Calls#205.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#206.src: Nice try, but that won't work.
The Canary Calls#206.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#207.src: Hey up! Aren't you that Wynn soldier we've heard about? You look proper tough, is all.
The Canary Calls#207.dst: 嘿！你不就是我们听说的那个 Wynn 士兵吗？你看起来真够强悍的。
The Canary Calls#207.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#208.src: No, this is definitely them! The name's {u}, right?
The Canary Calls#208.dst: 不，绝对就是他们！名字叫 {u}，对吧？
The Canary Calls#208.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#209.src: Woah, this kid's a soldier? I wish I had that kind of job... I'd imagine it's much better than this crap.
The Canary Calls#209.dst: 哇，这小子是士兵？真希望我也有那种工作……我猜比这破活好多了。
The Canary Calls#209.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#210.src: Yeah, I really hate this job, man. That and the chief makes me pull my hair out... In fact, I already went bald because of it!
The Canary Calls#210.dst: 是啊，我真的很讨厌这份工作，老兄。再加上工头让我烦到想拔头发……事实上，我已经因为他秃了！
The Canary Calls#210.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#211.src: Dude, the chief scares the crap out of me. I'm surprised that I still have this job. Looks like we might lose it if the mines ain't restored fast enough.
The Canary Calls#211.dst: 兄弟，工头吓死我了。我居然还没丢掉这份工作，真意外。看来如果矿坑没有尽快恢复，我们可能就要丢饭碗了。
The Canary Calls#211.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#212.src: I-I don't want to lose this job, man! I've got a wife and two goldfish!
The Canary Calls#212.dst: 我、我不想丢掉这份工作，老兄！我有老婆，还有两条金鱼！
The Canary Calls#212.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#213.src: Easy, Ryan. We won't lose it. We're in this together. will take care of it.
The Canary Calls#213.dst: 别急，Ryan。我们不会丢掉的。我们同舟共济。 会处理好的。
The Canary Calls#213.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#214.src: Our very lives are in your hands, soldier. Good luck, and be careful. The mines are quite treacherous even for people like you.
The Canary Calls#214.dst: 我们的身家性命就交到你手上了，士兵。祝你好运，千万小心。就算是你这样的人，矿坑也相当险恶。
The Canary Calls#214.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#215.src: We still can't believe we found you. I'm proper shocked.
The Canary Calls#215.dst: 我们到现在还不敢相信找到了你。我真的吓坏了。
The Canary Calls#215.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#216.src: We had to use that blasted archaic minecart system because the elevator was still busted.
The Canary Calls#216.dst: 因为升降梯还是坏的，我们只好用那套该死的老矿车系统。
The Canary Calls#216.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#217.src: Everyone was exhausted from it. But just when all hope was seemingly lost, we found you laying on the ground.
The Canary Calls#217.dst: 大家都累坏了。可就在似乎一切希望都破灭的时候，我们发现你倒在地上。
The Canary Calls#217.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#218.src: You were violently twitching about, as if you were possessed by something. It was scary.
The Canary Calls#218.dst: 你在剧烈地抽搐，好像被什么东西附身了一样。太吓人了。
The Canary Calls#218.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#219.src: Whatever the effects of that gas are, we want absolutely none of it. I'm never stepping foot inside of that bloody mine ever again.
The Canary Calls#219.dst: 不管那毒气有什么效果，我们一点都不想沾上。我再也不会踏进那该死的矿坑一步了。
The Canary Calls#219.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#220.src: For the sake of our jobs and {p}, the Colossus must be stopped.
The Canary Calls#220.dst: 为了我们的饭碗，也为了 {p}，巨像必须被阻止。
The Canary Calls#220.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#221.src: So, kindly, I will tell you again.
The Canary Calls#221.dst: 所以，我好心再跟你说一次。

The Canary Calls#222.src: Very good! Come on then, let me introduce to you our little feathered mascot.
The Canary Calls#222.dst: 很好！来吧，我给你介绍一下我们毛茸茸的小吉祥物。
The Canary Calls#222.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#223.src: I ran into a group of miners from {p}, a small mining settlement not far from where I lived. I've heard about this place.
The Canary Calls#223.dst: 我遇上了一群来自 {p} 的矿工，那是离我住处不远的一个小矿业聚落。我听说过那个地方。

The Canary Calls#224.src: It seems you have failed a lot of times. Would you like to skip this section?
The Canary Calls#224.dst: 看来你失败很多次了。要跳过这一段吗？

The Canary Calls#225.src: It seems that your spells are severely weakened by the gas. You should follow the rail tracks to find a way out of the mine.
The Canary Calls#225.dst: 看来你的法术被那股气体大幅削弱了。你该沿着轨道找出矿坑的出路。

The Canary Calls#226.src: It's blocked. Perhaps there's something around to break through?
The Canary Calls#226.dst: 被堵住了。也许附近有什么东西可以打穿？

The Canary Calls#227.src: The town is incredibly poor, yet they're right on top of an extremely rich coal deposit. Their future, just a stone's throw away. And yet...
The Canary Calls#227.dst: 那个镇穷得不像话，偏偏就坐在一座极其丰富的煤层上。他们的未来，近在咫尺。然而……

The Canary Calls#228.src: They still manage to struggle. A struggle that would be incredibly magnified by recent events. Indeed, those miners were also searching for survivors of that earthquake.
The Canary Calls#228.dst: 他们还是挣扎度日。而最近的事又把那份挣扎放大了无数倍。没错，那些矿工也在找那场地震的生还者。

The Canary Calls#229.src: Its influence was far and wide, and its strength unlike anything ever seen before. They told me that their town was absolutely devastated beyond recognition by the earthquake.
The Canary Calls#229.dst: 它波及的范围又远又广，强度更是前所未见。他们告诉我，他们的镇被那场地震毁得面目全非。

The Canary Calls#230.src: But words cannot describe the atrocities I saw when I first entered that place.
The Canary Calls#230.dst: 但我第一次踏进那个地方时看到的惨状，不是言语形容得出来的。

The Canary Calls#231.src: Families struggling trying to rescue their kin who were trapped by the debris;
The Canary Calls#231.dst: 一家家人拼命想把被瓦砾困住的亲人挖出来；

The Canary Calls#232.src: I heard nothing but complete silence, occasionally interrupted by the wails of the town's residents.
The Canary Calls#232.dst: 我听见的只有彻底的寂静，偶尔被镇民的哀号打断。

The Canary Calls#233.src: Despite being a grown man in my {~}'s, I could not help but feel like an innocent child at that moment.
The Canary Calls#233.dst: 尽管我已经是个 {~} 几岁的成年男人，那一刻我还是觉得自己像个天真的孩子。

The Canary Calls#234.src: Such a mournful existence. If this life had any meaning to begin with, it was meant for nothing but despair.
The Canary Calls#234.dst: 多么哀伤的存在。如果这一生本来就有什么意义，那意义也不过是为了绝望。

The Canary Calls#235.src: One of the miners who I met earlier brought me to a nearby area underneath a cliff, which was seemingly untouched by the earthquake.
The Canary Calls#235.dst: 先前遇到的其中一个矿工把我带到附近一处崖底，那里看起来没被地震碰到。

The Canary Calls#236.src: A lot of refugees made their homes here, desperately clinging on to the last thread of life. A lifestyle that I would need to adopt, whether I liked it or not.
The Canary Calls#236.dst: 很多难民在这里安了家，死命抓着最后一丝活路。不管我愿不愿意，那都会是我往后的日子。

The Canary Calls#237.src: But to my surprise, the miner offered me some money and a job to get me back up on my feet. So incredibly kind of him. He reminded me of my mother.
The Canary Calls#237.dst: 但出乎我意料，那个矿工给了我一点钱和一份工作，让我重新站起来。他好心得不可思议。他让我想起我母亲。

The Canary Calls#238.src: His name was Clight. Seemed like a nice fellow. Apparently he had gone through a similar situation as I did.
The Canary Calls#238.dst: 他叫 Clight。看起来是个好人。听说他也经历过跟我差不多的事。

The Canary Calls#239.src: Not as grave as mine, though. Lost his home and everything a few years back. Sought refuge in {p}. Now, he is well off and is seeking to become the chief miner one day.
The Canary Calls#239.dst: 不过没我的那么惨。几年前失去了家和一切。逃难到 {p}。如今他过得不错，还想着总有一天要当上矿场工头。

The Canary Calls#240.src: You have already pulled this lever.
The Canary Calls#240.dst: 你已经拉过这根拉杆了。

The Canary Calls#241.src: To return to your previous point, go back into the mineshaft at [{~},-{~}].
The Canary Calls#241.dst: 要回到刚才的地方，就从 [{~1},-{~2}] 的矿道回去。

The Canary Calls#244.src: I'm alaready dead, how is this even possible?
The Canary Calls#244.dst: 我早就死了，这怎么可能？
The Canary Calls#244.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#245.src: Okay, who even put those there in the first place?
The Canary Calls#245.dst: 好，那些东西到底是谁一开始放在那里的？
The Canary Calls#245.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#247.src: It felt nice the first time, but now it's...different.
The Canary Calls#247.dst: 第一次的感觉还不错，但现在……不一样了。
The Canary Calls#247.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#248.src: Hands off of those, if you would be so kind.

The Canary Calls#249.src: Took our canary with us and everything. Just another day in the life.
The Canary Calls#249.dst: 金丝雀什么的都带上了。不过是日子里又一天。

The Canary Calls#250.src: I was stood on a ledge overlooking a crevasse, where the gas supposedly was, to get a better look of the area.
The Canary Calls#250.dst: 我站在一处突岩上俯瞰那道裂隙——气体据说就在那里——想把地形看得清楚一点。

The Canary Calls#251.src: And then... He pushed me off. As if I was some kind of piece of trash.
The Canary Calls#251.dst: 然后……他把我推了下去。像丢一块垃圾那样。

The Canary Calls#252.src: He did it, that mudder Clight. He said those words with no hesitation, no sarcasm, no nothing.
The Canary Calls#252.dst: 是他做的，那个泥腿子 Clight。他说那些话的时候没有迟疑、没有嘲讽、什么都没有。

The Canary Calls#253.src: It was genuine. Or, at least, I think it was. I glanced at his eyes very briefly, and I saw tears. Tears of joy? Or...sadness?
The Canary Calls#253.dst: 那是真心的。至少我认为是。我很短暂地瞥了他的眼睛一眼，看见了泪。喜悦的泪？还是……悲伤的？

The Canary Calls#254.src: I don't even know what to think anymore. Everything I've experienced, all the moments we've shared, all the trust we've had for each other.
The Canary Calls#254.dst: 我已经不知道该怎么想了。我经历过的一切、我们一起度过的每一刻、我们之间所有的信任。

The Canary Calls#255.src: It was all a blatant lie. An act. And for what? Wealth? Power? Dominion? No... That is not the Clight I know. And yet, somehow, it happened.
The Canary Calls#255.dst: 全都是赤裸裸的谎。一场戏。而为的是什么？财富？权力？统治？不……那不是我认识的 Clight。然而，它就是发生了。

The Canary Calls#256.src: It happened. Yes, it did happen. It really did happen. Happen. Happen happen happen. Happy. Yes, I am happy. The happiest person in the world. Happiness.
The Canary Calls#256.dst: 它发生了。对，它确实发生了。它真的发生了。发生。发生发生发生。幸福。对，我很幸福。世界上最幸福的人。幸福。

The Canary Calls#257.src: Indeed, happiness is the meaning of life, if you are a naive little kid. Life has no meaning.
The Canary Calls#257.dst: 没错，幸福就是人生的意义——如果你是个天真的小鬼的话。人生没有意义。

The Canary Calls#258.src: How foolish it was of me to think it had any meaning.
The Canary Calls#258.dst: 我竟然以为它有意义，真是愚蠢。

The Canary Calls#259.src: No... The true meaning of life is to blindly walk a path to find that fabled 'meaning', only to find no end in sight.
The Canary Calls#259.dst: 不……人生真正的意义，是盲目地走在一条路上寻找那个传说中的“意义”，然后发现根本看不到尽头。

The Canary Calls#260.src: Suffering leads to the pursuit of happiness, which only leads back to suffering, and so on.
The Canary Calls#260.dst: 苦难引人追求幸福，而追求幸福又只会回到苦难，如此循环。

The Canary Calls#261.src: What is the point, really? Even inside my perfect {p}, people were still suffering.
The Canary Calls#261.dst: 到底有什么意义？就连在我那个完美的 {p} 里，人们也还是在受苦。

The Canary Calls#262.src: And Clight... Was it all...pointless? Was there...any point in my existence? Maybe I'll just... No.
The Canary Calls#262.dst: 还有 Clight……那一切都……没有意义吗？我的存在……有任何意义吗？也许我干脆……不。

The Canary Calls#263.src: There is only one more thing meant for this world. Destroy what's left of it. People won't need to suffer anymore.
The Canary Calls#263.dst: 这个世界只剩下一件该做的事。把剩下的都毁掉。人们就不必再受苦了。

The Canary Calls#264.src: I now finally understand why the Colossus claimed so many lives.
The Canary Calls#264.dst: 我现在终于明白 Colossus 为什么夺走了那么多性命。

The Canary Calls#265.src: I have decided, at long last. My true purpose in life. Kill Clight, destroy {p}, and restore order to the world.
The Canary Calls#265.dst: 我终于决定了。我此生真正的目的。杀掉 Clight、毁掉 {p}，让这个世界重归秩序。

The Canary Calls#266.src: We were going down into the mines to investigate a suspicious gas leakage.
The Canary Calls#266.dst: 我们要下矿坑去查一处可疑的气体泄漏。

The Canary Calls#267.src: I think I'm going insane. Strange apparitions keep appearing in the corner of my eye.
The Canary Calls#267.dst: 我想我快疯了。奇怪的幻影一直出现在我的眼角。

The Canary Calls#268.src: Were they ghosts? Or real people? I couldn't tell. It constantly feels as if I'm zoning out from time to time.
The Canary Calls#268.dst: 那是鬼魂？还是真人？我分不出来。我总觉得自己时不时就走神。

The Canary Calls#269.src: It's as if I am a figment of his imagination, real but not real. His judgment, clouded by perception. Wait, what did I just write?
The Canary Calls#269.dst: 就好像我是他想象出来的东西，真实而又不真实。他的判断被感知蒙蔽了。等等，我刚刚写了什么？

The Canary Calls#270.src: No, scratch that. No idea...where that came from... Ugh. My head... The pain is indescribable.
The Canary Calls#270.dst: 不，当我没写。不知道……那是从哪来的……唔。我的头……那种痛难以形容。

The Canary Calls#271.src: But it feels very good, like a nice little massage. What the...? There it is again.
The Canary Calls#271.dst: 但感觉很舒服，像被轻轻按摩。搞什么……？又来了。

The Canary Calls#272.src: It's like time stops, and suddenly there's words on the paper. Are they...the thoughts hidden deep within my subconscious...?
The Canary Calls#272.dst: 就像时间停住，然后纸上忽然多出字来。那些是……藏在我潜意识深处的念头吗……？

The Canary Calls#273.src: One of the strange apparitions I saw recently was what seemed to be a blue canary, like that one I brought with me on that day.
The Canary Calls#273.dst: 我最近看到的其中一个幻影，看起来像一只蓝色的金丝雀，就像我那天带去的那一只。

The Canary Calls#274.src: And it was...talking to me? It seemed like it was incredibly angry at me. It cursed at me, made threats against me, and wished I had never existed.
The Canary Calls#274.dst: 而它在……跟我说话？它好像对我气得要命。它咒骂我、威胁我，还说宁可我从来没存在过。

The Canary Calls#275.src: It didn't throw any regular curses, no, it threw the harshest curses and the most horrific threats at me. Was it real? Or just my imagination?
The Canary Calls#275.dst: 它骂的不是一般的脏话，不，它对我丢出的是最恶毒的咒骂和最可怕的威胁。那是真的吗？还是只是我的想象？

The Canary Calls#276.src: Likely the latter, but... what was it supposed to mean, then? Was it...a warning? Did I...glimpse the future?
The Canary Calls#276.dst: 大概是后者，可是……那又该是什么意思呢？那是……一个警告吗？我是不是……瞥见了未来？

The Canary Calls#277.src: Or was it just a manifestation of my thoughts? If so, then... perhaps it was him.
The Canary Calls#277.dst: 又或者那只是我念头的化身？若是如此，那……也许那就是他。

The Canary Calls#278.src: Indeed. The one who ruined my life and got away with it.
The Canary Calls#278.dst: 没错。那个毁了我一生却全身而退的人。

The Canary Calls#279.src: No... He will not get away with it. I will not allow that to happen. For the sake of the world, he must be stopped.
The Canary Calls#279.dst: 不……他别想全身而退。我不会让那种事发生。为了这个世界，必须阻止他。

The Canary Calls#280.src: He... That's him, right? Am I even thinking about the same thing...? Ugh, every part of my body is aching.
The Canary Calls#280.dst: 他……那是他吧？我现在想的到底是不是同一件事……？唔，我全身上下没一处不痛。

The Canary Calls#281.src: He... That's him, right? Am I even thinking about the same thing...? Ugh, every part of my body is aching.
The Canary Calls#281.dst: 他……那是他吧？我现在想的到底是不是同一件事……？唔，我全身上下没一处不痛。

The Canary Calls#282.src: I can't even write anymore. This may be the last entry in my journal. I will continue on while my flame still flickers.
The Canary Calls#282.dst: 我连字都写不下去了。这也许是这本日记的最后一篇。只要我这点火光还在摇曳，我就会走下去。

The Canary Calls#283.src: Rest assured, I will not die here. I cannot die here. I must do...his...bidding.
The Canary Calls#283.dst: 放心，我不会死在这里。我不能死在这里。我必须照……他的……吩咐去做。

The Canary Calls#284.src: I will change my identity, erase my past self from the face of the world, anything... Anything to achieve my goal.
The Canary Calls#284.dst: 我会换掉身份，把过去的自己从这世上抹去，什么都行……只要能达成我的目的。

The Canary Calls#285.src: But I will leave this journal here to remind future miners of the fabled 'meaning' they are hopelessly searching for.
The Canary Calls#285.dst: 但我会把这本日记留在这里，提醒后来的矿工：他们苦苦寻找的那个传说中的“意义”是什么样子。

The Canary Calls#286.src: Stop searching for it, there is no point in finding meaning. If you persist, then... you may end up like me.
The Canary Calls#286.dst: 别再找了，找出意义没有任何用处。你要是坚持下去，那……你可能会变成我这样。

The Canary Calls#287.src: Two paths, side by side. Present, and future. One of them is...hopeless. The other is the road I must walk.
The Canary Calls#287.dst: 两条路并排着。现在，与未来。其中一条……毫无希望。另一条是我非走不可的路。

The Canary Calls#288.src: Our paths won't cross. But... Should we, in fact, ever meet up... On that day...
The Canary Calls#288.dst: 我们的路不会交会。但是……万一我们真的碰上了……到那一天……

The Canary Calls#289.src: Today, I was nominated for chief of the {p} coal mine. Right hand of the mayor.
The Canary Calls#289.dst: 今天，我被提名为 {p} 煤矿场的工头。镇长的右手。

The Canary Calls#290.src: Four years of hard work finally paid off. This is my chance to find the answers we are all looking for.
The Canary Calls#290.dst: 四年的苦干总算有了回报。这是我找出我们所有人都在找的答案的机会。

The Canary Calls#291.src: The answers that I once began to search for on that fabled day when I lost everything.
The Canary Calls#291.dst: 那些答案，是我在失去一切的那个传说般的日子里开始寻找的。

The Canary Calls#292.src: Finally, a chance to find a way for us to live in peace again. No more tragedy, no more disaster.
The Canary Calls#292.dst: 终于有机会找出让我们重新安稳过日子的办法。不再有悲剧，不再有灾难。

The Canary Calls#293.src: Just...happiness. Happiness, security, and stability. With the power as chief, I will make that my goal.
The Canary Calls#293.dst: 只有……幸福。幸福、安全，还有安定。有了工头的权力，我要把那当成我的目标。

The Canary Calls#294.src: Indeed, the perfect {p} will be realized under my leadership.
The Canary Calls#294.dst: 没错，完美的 {p} 会在我的带领下实现。

The Canary Calls#295.src: In order to achieve security and stability, my first course of action as chief will be to make everyone into miners to ensure that no one is left without a job.
The Canary Calls#295.dst: 为了达成安全与安定，我当上工头的第一件事，就是让每一个人都成为矿工，确保没有人失业。

The Canary Calls#296.src: They will work towards a common goal - eliminating the threat of the Colossus. {p} will become a safe haven in the Canyon, a sanctuary in the midst of chaos.
The Canary Calls#296.dst: 他们会为一个共同的目标努力——消除 Colossus 的威胁。{p} 会成为峡谷里的避风港，混乱之中的庇护所。

The Canary Calls#297.src: No one will be left homeless or poor, unhappy or misfortuned. Freedom from suffering, in its simplicity. It is...the best existence possible.
The Canary Calls#297.dst: 没有人会无家可归或贫困，没有人会不幸或倒霉。单纯地，从苦难中解脱。那是……可能存在的最好的样子。

The Canary Calls#298.src: I was running against Clight. As a man of high respect and trust, I was not surprised he was nominated.
The Canary Calls#298.dst: 我的对手是 Clight。他是个备受敬重与信任的人，被提名我并不意外。

The Canary Calls#299.src: Regardless of whoever wins, I trust that he will do great things. We desire the same thing, after all.
The Canary Calls#299.dst: 不管谁赢，我相信他都会做出一番大事。毕竟我们要的是同一件事。

The Canary Calls#300.src: Prevent the Colossus from interfering with our futures. The one who ravaged our homes, ruined our lives, and shattered all hope.
The Canary Calls#300.dst: 不让 Colossus 再干扰我们的未来。就是它摧毁了我们的家、毁了我们的人生、碾碎了所有希望。

The Canary Calls#301.src: We wouldn't have to live in fear anymore. I know it's wishful thinking, but... a man can dream.
The Canary Calls#301.dst: 我们就不必再活在恐惧里了。我知道这是一厢情愿，但是……人总可以做梦吧。

The Canary Calls#302.src: I think I'm starting to get used to this place. I've been working for a while now as a coal miner.
The Canary Calls#302.dst: 我想我开始习惯这个地方了。我当煤矿工也有一阵子了。

The Canary Calls#303.src: It may not be the easiest job in the world, but I'm at least earning money for a roof over my head and for food on the table.
The Canary Calls#303.dst: 这也许不是世上最轻松的工作，但至少我赚到了遮头的屋瓦和桌上的饭菜。

The Canary Calls#304.src: I wake up every day thinking not of the grueling task at the start of the day, but of the rewards I'll reap at the end of the day.
The Canary Calls#304.dst: 我每天醒来想的不是这一天开头那些累死人的活，而是这一天结束时能收到的回报。

The Canary Calls#305.src: It's kind of funny, really. It's funny how much I've changed over such a short period of time.
The Canary Calls#305.dst: 说起来还真有点好笑。好笑的是我在这么短的时间里变了这么多。

The Canary Calls#306.src: That day, when that man Clight offered to help me walk on this twisted, beaten path, I started to look at life differently. Taking the good with the bad, you know?
The Canary Calls#306.dst: 那一天，那个叫 Clight 的人愿意帮我走上这条扭曲又难走的路，我开始用不一样的眼光看人生。好的坏的一起收下，你懂吧？

The Canary Calls#307.src: Clight was like the light at the end of the tunnel. Everyone aspired to be like him.
The Canary Calls#307.dst: Clight 就像隧道尽头的那道光。每个人都想成为他那样的人。

The Canary Calls#308.src: He was a hard worker with relentless determination to make {p} and its residents the best they can be.
The Canary Calls#308.dst: 他做事卖力，而且有一股不肯罢休的决心，要让 {p} 和这里的居民变成最好的样子。

The Canary Calls#309.src: When we went to the bar after a long day's work, Clight would often bring us boilo, a sweet citrusy alcoholic beverage originating from {p}.
The Canary Calls#309.dst: 忙完一整天上酒吧的时候，Clight 常常会带 boilo 给我们，那是一种源自 {p} 的甜味柑橘调酒。

The Canary Calls#310.src: Traditionally, everyone has their own unique take on boilo. My boilo, which I loved making, was something I was always proud of.
The Canary Calls#310.dst: 照传统，每个人都有自己一套独门的 boilo 做法。我很喜欢调我的那一款，也一直为它感到骄傲。

The Canary Calls#311.src: But Clight's boilo? It was by far the best boilo I've ever tasted. He would do that just to put a smile on everyone's faces. Indeed... I've seen that smile, somewhere before.
The Canary Calls#311.dst: 但 Clight 的 boilo 呢？那是我喝过最好的一款，差距还很大。他那么做只是为了让每个人脸上多一点笑。没错……那个笑容，我在别的地方见过。

The Canary Calls#312.src: Clight was the only person who I really liked. Looked up to, even. He was always there for me in my times of need.
The Canary Calls#312.dst: Clight 是我唯一真心喜欢的人。甚至是我景仰的人。我需要的时候他一直都在。

The Canary Calls#313.src: I would go as far as saying he's perfect. However, when I look into his eyes... I see imperfection.
The Canary Calls#313.dst: 我甚至会说他是完美的。可是，当我望进他的眼睛……我看见了不完美。

The Canary Calls#314.src: Like a diamond, there is always something flawed about it. Something just... doesn't feel right.
The Canary Calls#314.dst: 就像钻石一样，总有一处是有瑕疵的。就是有什么……让人觉得不对。

The Canary Calls#315.src: Like he's trying to hide something by acting in such a way. Or perhaps... I see my own reflection. Indeed, we are...the same.
The Canary Calls#315.dst: 好像他那样表现是为了藏住什么。又或者……我看见的是自己的倒影。没错，我们是……一样的。

The Canary Calls#316.src: The past couple of years have done wonders for myself and {p}.
The Canary Calls#316.dst: 过去这几年，对我自己和 {p} 都是脱胎换骨。

The Canary Calls#317.src: Ever since I became chief, I have not lived a single day that I felt was unfulfilling.
The Canary Calls#317.dst: 自从当上工头，我没有一天过得觉得空虚。

The Canary Calls#318.src: I was able to revolutionize the coal industry and bring in much more profit.
The Canary Calls#318.dst: 我彻底改造了煤矿这一行，带进了多得多的利润。

The Canary Calls#319.src: With that profit, I began planning reconstruction for {p}, as part of my goal in mitigating the Colossus' impact on the city.
The Canary Calls#319.dst: 靠着那些利润，我开始规划 {p} 的重建，作为减轻 Colossus 对这座城市冲击的一环。

The Canary Calls#320.src: I planned to use expensive materials that would, in theory, prevent earthquakes from touching the city.
The Canary Calls#320.dst: 我打算用昂贵的材料，理论上可以让地震碰不到这座城。

The Canary Calls#321.src: It took many years, but today, the project has finally been completed.
The Canary Calls#321.dst: 这花了好多年，但今天，这项工程终于完成了。

The Canary Calls#322.src: The new {p} is completely unrecognizable compared to the old one, and I daresay it's one of the best looking cities in Gavel, as well as the safest in the Canyon.
The Canary Calls#322.dst: 新的 {p} 跟旧的比起来完全认不出来，我敢说它是 Gavel 最好看的城市之一，也是峡谷里最安全的。

The Canary Calls#323.src: Clight and I have also been getting along well.
The Canary Calls#323.dst: 我和 Clight 也处得不错。

The Canary Calls#324.src: Despite losing in the chief election, he has been there by my side.
The Canary Calls#324.dst: 虽然工头选举输了，他还是一直在我身边。

The Canary Calls#325.src: Second in command, if you will. However, even though we are good friends, we still have arguments from time to time, mostly about how to proceed further with {p}.
The Canary Calls#325.dst: 算是第二把交椅吧。不过即使我们是好朋友，还是时不时会吵起来，多半是为了 {p} 接下来该怎么走。

The Canary Calls#326.src: He always mentions that rebuilding the city was a waste of money, instead wishing it funded a direct way of dealing with the Colossus, rather than an indirect one.
The Canary Calls#326.dst: 他老是说重建这座城是在浪费钱，宁可那笔钱拿去直接对付 Colossus，而不是绕这么一圈。

The Canary Calls#327.src: Truthfully, I don't know if I can answer that. I just... I don't know if I can. I'm... afraid of the consequences.
The Canary Calls#327.dst: 老实说，我不知道自己答不答得出来。我就是……不知道自己做不做得到。我……害怕后果。

The Canary Calls#328.src: It is a huge task. Anxiety inducing, in fact. I just can't bring myself to face it.
The Canary Calls#328.dst: 那是一件巨大的工程。说实话，光想就焦虑。我就是没办法让自己去面对。

The Canary Calls#329.src: And I'm not sure why. I just... want to live a peaceful life. No more problems, no more anxiety, no more fearing the future.
The Canary Calls#329.dst: 我也不确定为什么。我只是……想过安稳的日子。不再有问题，不再有焦虑，不再害怕未来。

The Canary Calls#330.src: This new {p} can make that happen. Yes... The endless now. {p}, in stasis, forever frozen in time.
The Canary Calls#330.dst: 新的 {p} 做得到这件事。是的……无尽的当下。{p} 停滞着，永远冻结在时间里。

The Canary Calls#331.src: Miners forever working to maintain the status quo. As it...should be.
The Canary Calls#331.dst: 矿工们永远劳动着，维持现状。本来……就该如此。

The Canary Calls#332.src: Food and water are incredibly scarce. My clothing is beginning to wear and tear.
The Canary Calls#332.dst: 食物和水少得可怜。我的衣服开始磨损破裂。

The Canary Calls#333.src: My sanity is dwindling by the minute. Darkness envelops the caverns, and not a soul to be seen.
The Canary Calls#333.dst: 我的神志一分一分地耗尽。黑暗吞没了洞穴，见不到半个人影。

The Canary Calls#334.src: Yet somehow, I've managed to survive down in the mines for a couple days. Perhaps it's luck? Or fate? I don't even know anymore.
The Canary Calls#334.dst: 但不知怎的，我在矿坑底下撑过了好几天。也许是运气？还是命运？我也不知道了。

The Canary Calls#335.src: It feels as if my memory and thinking skills are extremely clouded. It hurts me to even write this very passage.
The Canary Calls#335.dst: 我觉得自己的记忆和思考都被蒙上了一层厚厚的雾。连写下这一段都让我难受。

The Canary Calls#336.src: This gas... It's not normal. In fact, I don't even think it's a gas.
The Canary Calls#336.dst: 这股气体……不正常。其实我根本不觉得那是气体。

The Canary Calls#337.src: It's like... some kind of magical force. There's this constant pressure against my head, as if it's about to explode, and I can't stop coughing.
The Canary Calls#337.dst: 那比较像……某种魔法的力量。我的头一直被某种压力顶着，像是快要炸开，而且我咳个不停。

The Canary Calls#338.src: I tried casting the handful of Air spells I still remembered from my childhood, and they changed form...?
The Canary Calls#338.dst: 我试着施了几个小时候还记得的风属性法术，结果它们变了形……？

The Canary Calls#339.src: Although they became a lot weaker. Maybe I'm just misremembering, given that I barely used them. Regardless, I have never experienced anything like this, in all my days of mining.
The Canary Calls#339.dst: 而且弱了很多。也许只是我记错了，毕竟我几乎没用过。不管怎样，我挖了这么多年的矿，从来没遇过这种事。

The Canary Calls#340.src: This force... Could it be the Colossus' doing? If it really is, then that means... No...
The Canary Calls#340.dst: 这股力量……会是 Colossus 搞的鬼吗？如果真的是，那就表示……不……

The Canary Calls#341.src: No matter. Time remains but a mere obstacle in my path.
The Canary Calls#341.dst: 无所谓。时间不过是我路上的一个小障碍罢了。

The Canary Calls#342.src: It will not stop me from achieving my goal, nor will this force. Nothing will stop me, for I am destined to be this world's saviour.
The Canary Calls#342.dst: 它阻止不了我达成目标，这股力量也一样。没有东西拦得住我，因为我注定要成为这个世界的救世主。

The Canary Calls#343.src: People are born into the passage of fate, doomed to float aimlessly in the sea of suffering.
The Canary Calls#343.dst: 人生下来就落进命运的河道，注定在苦难之海里漫无目的地漂着。

The Canary Calls#344.src: Many have tried, but none have ever managed to escape its torrential flow. And yet, recent events defy that fate.
The Canary Calls#344.dst: 很多人试过，但没有一个逃得出那道奔流。然而，最近发生的事违背了那个命运。

The Canary Calls#345.src: I am...the chosen one. Chosen by the Colossus to rid the world of the cycle of suffering, the very nature of the world, the very fabric of reality.
The Canary Calls#345.dst: 我是……被选中的那一个。被 Colossus 选中，来为这个世界除去苦难的轮回、除去这世界的本质、除去现实的经纬。

The Canary Calls#346.src: There is only one meant for this world, and I AM IT. That is ME, and NO ONE ELSE.
The Canary Calls#346.dst: 这个世界只需要一个人，而那就是我。是我，不会是别人。

The Canary Calls#347.src: a child wandering around looking for their missing family; people frantically rummaging through the rubble to find their belongings.
The Canary Calls#347.dst: 一个孩子四处游荡，找着不见的家人；人们发了疯似的在碎石堆里翻找自己的东西。

The Canary Calls#348.src: 'When I lost everything, I tried to look towards the future,' he said. 'It was hard, but it's the mentality that keeps me going.' His words inspired me to live on another day.
The Canary Calls#348.dst: “当我失去一切的时候，我试着把眼光放到未来。”他说。“那很难，但就是这个心态让我撑下来。”他的话让我愿意再多活一天。

The Canary Calls#349.src: indeed... you are the one who can destroy the colossus.
The Canary Calls#349.dst: 没错……你就是那个能够摧毁 colossus 的人。

The Canary Calls#350.src: 'This is for your own good. Goodbye.' Those were the last words I heard from him.
The Canary Calls#350.dst: “这是为你好。再见了。”那是我从他那里听到的最后一句话。

The Canary Calls#351.src: 'You're letting this continue to be a problem. Destroy the Colossus and there won't have to be any more worrying,' he says.
The Canary Calls#351.dst: “你放着这个问题不管。把 Colossus 毁掉，就不必再担心了。”他说。
